verdict.rationale: Greptile documents an official CLI where `greptile review` reviews the feature-branch diff in about 60 seconds, and coding agents can call it to review their own code, so the local-diff review core is covered. Nothing in the pack shows CI-script usage or a machine-readable output format, and no independent hands-on use of the CLI review is cited. Missing for 10: documented machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output, explicit CI/headless usage guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI review command.
